title: FPF Assessor MCP Server Tool Manifest
description: Static tool definitions for the fpf-assessor MCP server. This file mirrors the MCP tools/list response format. A server may serve this verbatim, and clients can validate tool calls against these schemas without runtime discovery.

tools.name: assess-oracle-latency
tools.title: Oracle Latency Assessor
tools.description: Assess how fast and cheap real-world feedback is on decisions. Scores 0 (fast, cheap) or 1 (slow, expensive, noisy, risky) based on CI/CD, test automation, and monitoring infrastructure.

project_root.description: Absolute path to project root directory

context.description: Optional: session or problem domain context for scoping

tools.name: assess-evidence-maturity
tools.title: Evidence Maturity Assessor
tools.description: Assess whether claims are verified or assumed. Scores 0 (verified/testable) or 1 (assumed/untested) based on test coverage, type strictness, and validation schema presence.

project_root.description: Absolute path to project root directory

context.description: Optional: session or problem domain context for scoping

tools.name: assess-vocabulary-risk
tools.title: Vocabulary Risk Assessor
tools.description: Assess whether language is stable across parties. Scores 0 (stable) or 1 (breaking down) based on glossary presence, term consistency, and naming conventions.

project_root.description: Absolute path to project root directory

context.description: Optional: session or problem domain context for scoping

tools.name: assess-stake-breadth
tools.title: Stake Breadth Assessor
tools.description: Assess how many roles, specialists, or agents are involved. Scores 0 (single) or 1 (multiple). Tool output is advisory — agent must confirm.

project_root.description: Absolute path to project root directory

context.description: Optional: session or problem domain context for scoping

tools.name: assess-audience-divergence
tools.title: Audience Divergence Assessor
tools.description: Assess how many audiences need aligned outputs. Scores 0 (one) or 1 (multiple). Tool output is advisory — agent must confirm.

project_root.description: Absolute path to project root directory

context.description: Optional: session or problem domain context for scoping

tools.name: assess-reversibility
tools.title: Reversibility Assessor
tools.description: Assess how costly a wrong decision is. Scores 0 (cheap) or 1 (irreversible/high-cost). Tool output is advisory — agent must confirm.

project_root.description: Absolute path to project root directory

context.description: Optional: session or problem domain context for scoping

tools.name: assess-calibration
tools.title: Prediction Calibration Assessor
tools.description: Compute Brier score decomposition from a prediction log. Measures whether the agent's confidence matches correctness (calibration). Uses scikit-learn brier_score_loss as reference implementation. Requires resolved predictions (actual_outcome not null).

stratify_by.description: Optional: compute separate Brier scores per stratum

brier_score.description: Brier score (original 1950 formulation: 0-2). Lower = better calibration.

reliability.description: REL component: how close are predicted probabilities to observed frequencies? 0 = perfect.

resolution.description: RES component: how much do predictions differ from baseline? Higher = better.

uncertainty.description: UNC component: inherent outcome uncertainty. Baseline = o*(1-o).

skill_score.description: Brier Skill Score. 1 = perfect, 0 = baseline, negative = worse.

baseline_score.description: Brier score of baseline model (constant prediction = mean outcome frequency).

n_incomplete.description: Number of predictions not yet resolved.

by_stratum.description: Brier scores per stratum if stratify_by provided.

diagnostics.description: Interpretive guidance. Flags if n < 1000 for rare events (Wilks 2010).

tools.name: assess-causal-effect
tools.title: Causal Effect Estimator
tools.description: Estimate Average Treatment Effect (ATE) of FPF on reasoning quality using Rubin Causal Model. Requires controlled experiment data (session-observation records) and experiment configuration (ab-experiment-config). Supports difference-in-means, doubly robust, propensity score matching, IPW, and regression adjustment estimators.

observations.description: Per-session observation records conforming to session-observation.schema.json

experiment_config.description: Experiment design configuration defining treatment/control and methodology

estimator.description: Estimator to apply. difference_in_means for balanced RCT. doubly_robust recommended for general use.

ate.description: Average Treatment Effect: E[Y(1) - Y(0)]. Positive = FPF improves outcome.

att_by_stratum.description: ATE per stratum if blocking variables configured.

confidence.description: Tool's confidence in the score. MCP tools 0.80-0.99. Agent fallback 0.50-0.75.

rationale.description: Why this score. Must cite specific evidence.

probes.description: What was checked to arrive at this score
